description: This is a test source file for TLS (Transport Layer Security) support in Orleans connections. It contains unit tests for certificate creation, TLS configuration for clients and silos, and end-to-end TLS communication testing, including mutual TLS and certificate validation modes. The file defines test classes, configuration helpers, a test grain interface, and implementation used to verify secure communication in Orleans clusters.

classes.name: TlsConnectionTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for TLS functionality in Orleans, including certificate creation, TLS configuration, and end-to-end communication tests.

classes.name: TlsClientConfigurator
classes.description: Configures TLS settings for Orleans clients, setting certificates, protocol versions, and validation policies.

classes.name: TlsServerConfigurator
classes.description: Configures TLS settings for Orleans silos, including certificates, protocol versions, and validation policies.

classes.name: IPingGrain
classes.description: Interface for a test grain that echoes back input, used to verify data transmission over TLS.

classes.name: PingGrain
classes.description: Implementation of IPingGrain that echoes back the input string. Used in TLS communication tests.

methods.name: CanCreateCertificates
methods.description: Tests that certificates can be created, encoded, and decoded correctly.

methods.name: TlsEndToEnd
methods.description: End-to-end test of TLS communication under various certificate and mode configurations, verifying proper connection establishment and data integrity.
